snippet.title: Donutal - Gameplay Trailer | Arc Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Donutal is an alien-screening adventure game centered around the art of dialogue and uncovering hidden truths. Set in the year 2206, players step into the shoes of an immigration official freshly awakened from cryosleep. Your mission? Vet the diverse extra-terrestrial travelers arriving on Earth and discern their true intentions.

Arc System Works has unleashed a brand-new system overview trailer today, diving deeper into the game's core mechanics. "Donutal" is officially slated for a 2026 release on Steam. Fans can add the game to their Steam Wishlist today to stay updated on its launch.

Store Link:
Steam: https://bit.ly/DonutalSteam
